summary: YAML documentation is mainly for filters, tests and modules; other plugin types should usually keep docs in the code file.
questions: Should I use YAML doc files for lookup or callback plugins?
Which plugin types are adjacent YAML docs meant for?

answer_card.title: Plugin types for YAML docs
answer_card.answer_md: Mainly **filters, tests and modules**. Other types can use it, but keeping docs in the same file as the code is recommended.
